description: **New tool.** `dirstat scan` summarizes the files under a directory grouped by format, with counts, sizes, and lines of code; supports ext/type/hybrid grouping, gitignore handling, hidden/exclude/depth filters, and multi-key sorting
Colored terminal tables with dark/light themes, unicode/ascii border styles, terminal-width adaptation, singleton collapsing, and a text/binary legend
Machine-readable JSON output (`--output json`) with a stable, additive-only schema
